number.why: The reported renal composite HR is 0.87 (95% CI 0.76–1.01), using the ≥40% eGFR decline threshold and follow-up through study end. Agreement includes the ruling's qualification: the served intention-to-treat label cannot be verified from this endpoint's empty population field.

quotes.span: The first secondary outcome was a composite of kidney failure, a sustained decrease from baseline of at least 40% in the eGFR, or death from renal causes.
The secondary composite outcome occurred in 350 patients (9.5%) in the finerenone group and in 395 (10.8%) in the placebo group (hazard ratio, 0.87; 95% CI, 0.76 to 1.01).

entry.why: Eligibility establishes adults with diabetic kidney disease and type 2 diabetes; the abstract establishes randomized, double-blind comparison of finerenone with placebo. This establishes entry eligibility, not proof of kidney benefit.

quotes.span: Inclusion Criteria: * Men or women ≥18 years of age * Subjects with Type Type 2 Diabetes Mellitus as defined by the American Diabetes Association * Diagnosis of Diabetic Kidney Disease with persistent high albuminuria or persistent very high albuminuria at the Run-In and Screening Visit
In this double-blind trial, we randomly assigned patients with CKD and type 2 diabetes to receive finerenone or placebo.
